title: The Rabbit and the Wise Owl

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look, friends! The tall grass is wiggling!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: I see two long, long ears... and a fluffy white tail!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who is hiding? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Boing! It's me! I'm Rosie the rabbit!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Hello, friends! I love hopping, and munching, and playing!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Rosie! I'm Bobo! Wow, you hop so high!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rabbits are very quiet. But look at Rosie's nose!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Sniff, sniff! Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now you! Wiggle your nose like Rosie. Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Hee hee! What a wiggly nose!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rosie wiggles her nose to smell the yummy grass.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Here are three amazing rabbit facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number one. A rabbit's teeth never stop growing!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Rosie munches lots of grass and hay, to keep her teeth just right.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Munch, munch, munch! Yum!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number two. Rabbits have eyes on the sides of their head.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Rosie can see almost all the way around her, without turning!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Rosie, can you see me back here?

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Yes, I can, Bobo! I see your red scarf!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number three. Wild rabbits live in burrows, under the ground.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A burrow is a cosy home with lots of tunnels!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: This is my front door! Pop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Today, Rosie wants to play with her friends.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hi, Rosie! Let's have a race to the finish line!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Yes! I'm super fast! Ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ready... steady... go!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: I win! I'm the fastest! You're all too slow!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Puff, puff... wait for us, Rosie!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Again! Race back to the start! Go!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Too slow! I win again!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Rosie, it's not fun when you always leave us behind.

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Yeah. Let's go and play by the pond, Bobo.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And Mila, Leo and Bobo walked away.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Oh no. Now I have nobody to play with.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Rosie hopped to the big old tree, where the wise owl lives.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Hello? Wise Owl? Are you there?

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Hoo... hoo... Oh! Hello, little Rosie. I was sleeping.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Owls often sleep in the daytime, and wake up at night!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Their big eyes help them see in the dark.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Wise Owl, my friends went away. Nobody wants to play with me.

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Hmm. When you race, Rosie, what do your friends see?

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Um... my fluffy tail?

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Hoo hoo! Yes. Only your tail. Far, far away.

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Being a good friend is not about being first.

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: A good friend waits... and a good friend helps.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What should Rosie do? Hop even faster, or wait for her friends?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Ooh, I know! Hop even FASTER!

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Hoo hoo! Not this time, Leo.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: That's right, friends! Rosie should wait for her friends!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: I will wait for my friends! Thank you, Wise Owl!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rosie hopped back to find her friends.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Mila, Leo, Bobo... I'm sorry I left you behind.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Can we play together? This time, I will wait for you.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Of course, Rosie! Friends forgive each other.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Yay! A together race!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's hop together! Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you hop too? Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Whoa! Oof! I tripped on the log!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Rosie stopped. She did not hop away...

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Are you OK, Bobo? Here, hold my paw!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Thank you, Rosie! You are a good friend!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And they all crossed the finish line... together!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: We all win!

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: Hoo hoo! Now THAT is a true friend!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Good friends wait for each other, and help each other.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How do YOU help your friends?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The sun went down. Rosie hopped home to her cosy burrow.

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Good night, everyone!

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: And good morning to me! Hoo hoo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How does Rosie smell the yummy grass?

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: With my wiggly nose! Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A rabbit's teeth never stop... what?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Growing! That's why rabbits munch lots of grass.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where do wild rabbits live?

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: In a burrow, under the ground!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When does the wise owl sleep?

vo.speaker: willow
vo.text: In the daytime! Hoo hoo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what does a good friend do?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: A good friend waits, and helps!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Wait for your friends!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Help your friends!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Play together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now you say it! Wait, help, and play together!

vo.speaker: rosie
vo.text: Bye bye, friends! Sniff, sniff!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time!
